Etcura v0.0.5 — a multi-cluster workspace for comparing, syncing, and watching changes

## New: multi-cluster workspace

- **Open several connections at once.** Tabs keep their own tree, search, selected key, and edit buffer. Environment labels and read-only status stay visible when you switch between clusters.
- **Compare two prefixes.** Map different paths across clusters and filter by source-only, target-only, changed, or identical keys. Each side uses a fixed revision. Inspect values side by side with line diffs, JSON fields, binary Base64, or a selected Protobuf message type.
- **Preview and sync selected keys.** Review the destination and the selected creates and updates before applying. Writes check the target revision and preserve existing target leases. Source-only keys with leases can be created as permanent when explicitly selected. See the outcome of each item, including conflicts and writes that need verification.
- **Watch changes.** Follow an exact key or prefix, inspect before and after values, and keep the timeline open while working in another tab. Watches resume after a short disconnect and mark gaps when etcd has compacted the required history.

## Downloads

| Platform | Archive |
|---|---|
| macOS Apple Silicon | `etcura-darwin-arm64.zip` |
| macOS Intel | `etcura-darwin-amd64.zip` |
| macOS Universal | `etcura-darwin-universal.zip` |
| Windows x64 | `etcura-windows-amd64.zip` |
| Windows ARM64 | `etcura-windows-arm64.zip` |
| Linux x64 | `etcura-linux-amd64.zip` |
| Linux ARM64 | `etcura-linux-arm64.zip` |

SHA-256 checksums are attached alongside each archive (`*.sha256`).

## Install

- **macOS** — unzip and drag `etcura.app` into /Applications. Builds use ad-hoc signing. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/SH-Wang123/etcura/blob/v0.0.5/README.en.md#download--install-releases-recommended-for-most-users).
- **Windows** — unzip and run `etcura.exe`. The app requires the WebView2 Runtime. See the [Windows guide](https://github.com/SH-Wang123/etcura/blob/v0.0.5/docs/WINDOWS.md).
- **Linux** — unzip and run `./etcura`. The build requires GTK3 and WebKitGTK 4.1.

## 中文

Etcura v0.0.5 推出**多集群变更工作台**，可在同一窗口完成前缀对比、选择性同步和实时监听。

- **多连接工作区**。同时打开多个连接，各标签保留各自的目录树、搜索、选中 key 和编辑草稿。切换时可看到环境标签和只读状态。
- **前缀对比**。支持两边使用不同路径，各自按固定 revision 读取。按仅源端、仅目标端、值不同和相同筛选，可并排查看行差异、JSON 字段、Base64 或选定 Protobuf 类型的解码结果。
- **预览并同步所选 key**。执行前核对目标环境及新增、更新项。写入检查目标 revision，更新保留已有目标 Lease。源端带租约的新增项可明确选择按永久 key 创建。结果逐项显示，包括冲突和待核对的写入。
- **实时变更时间线**。可监听单 key 或前缀，查看变更前后值，并在切换工作区时继续监听。短暂断线后接续，历史被 etcd 压缩时标记缺口。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SH-Wang123/etcura/compare/v0.0.4...v0.0.5
